CratesioFilter.description:
Filters for downloads through the crates.io proxy.

The fields are the same as in [`RegistryFilter`]. Both are separate structs
because the CLI flag prefix is set per struct.

license_enabled.description: Deny downloads of crates whose license is not allowed

license_exempt_crates.description: Crates (comma-separated) that are allowed regardless of their license

license_unknown.description:
Decision for crates without a known or valid license: "deny" or "allow".
A license that is no valid SPDX expression counts as unknown

DocQueueEntryResponse.description: Entry in the documentation build queue

url.description: URL to access the uploaded documentation

build_timeout_seconds.description:
Max duration of a single rustdoc build in seconds (0 = unlimited).
Builds that take longer are killed and the crate is skipped.

build_wrapper.description:
Command prefix (comma-separated) for the rustdoc build process.

Building docs compiles the published crate, which runs its build
scripts and proc macros. Kellnr runs every build in a child process
with a cleared environment, so no `KELLNR_*` settings or secrets are
passed on. Cargo's own `CARGO_*` variables are kept, so a registry
token in `CARGO_REGISTRIES_<NAME>_TOKEN` is visible to build scripts
and should belong to a dedicated read-only user.
The build still runs as the Kellnr user: it can read every
file Kellnr can read (for example the config file or the `SQLite`
database, e.g. via `include_str!`) and it has network access. Kellnr
only publishes the files rustdoc generates, but the build can write
such content into the generated docs of the crate. Only enable docs
for crates you trust, or set a wrapper that confines the build, e.g.
with bubblewrap:
`["bwrap", "--ro-bind", "/", "/", "--tmpfs", "<data_dir>",
"--bind", "<data_dir>/doc_queue", "<data_dir>/doc_queue",
"--bind", "<cargo_home>", "<cargo_home>", "--tmpfs", "/etc/kellnr",
"--dev", "/dev", "--proc", "/proc", "--tmpfs", "/tmp",
"--unshare-pid", "--die-with-parent", "--"]`.
The wrapper is followed by the Kellnr binary and its arguments.

enabled.description:
Enable documentation hosting

Building docs runs the build scripts and proc macros of every
published crate on the Kellnr host. See `build_wrapper` before
enabling this for publishers you do not fully trust.

allow_http.description: Allow plain HTTP connections. Needed when `endpoint` points at an HTTP endpoint.

endpoint.description:
Base URL override for self-hosted or emulator endpoints (e.g. fake-gcs-server
in tests). When unset, requests go to the public Google Cloud Storage API.

skip_signature.description:
Skip credential lookup and request signing. Only for unauthenticated endpoints
such as emulators. When false, credentials come from the environment
(Application Default Credentials).

has_secret.description: Whether deliveries are signed. The secret itself is never returned.

LeafMeta.description:
Per-leaf metadata for the dynamic UI. All fields except `value`/`source`
are stable per build (or, in the case of `default`, per binary), so the UI
can treat the response as both data and schema.

cli_flag.description: CLI flag string (e.g. `"--registry-data-dir, -d"`) when one exists.

default.description: Compiled-in default value in the same shape as `value`.

label.description: Optional display label override; `None` means the UI humanizes the key.

secret.description: `true` for `#[configurable(secret)]` leaves, the UI masks the value.

source.description: Where the active value came from.

type.description: JSON-flavoured type tag the UI uses to pick a renderer.

value.description: Active value as a JSON value (boolean, number, string, array, null).

LicenseUnknown.description:
What the license filter does with a crate whose license is unknown: none
is declared, the expression does not parse, or it could not be fetched.

crate_versions_found.description: Number of crate/version pairs found under the local docs directory.

started.description: `false` when there was no local docs directory to migrate from.

NameOrDescription.description:
A free-form crate search query, matched against crate names and descriptions.

Unlike [`crate::original_name::OriginalName`] the content is not restricted
to crate-name characters, because a description search takes arbitrary text.
Only the length is bounded, so an oversized query cannot turn into an
oversized `LIKE` pattern scanned across every row.

additional_audiences.description: Additional audiences accepted in the ID token besides the client ID

admin_group_claim.description:
Claim name to check for admin group membership (e.g., "groups"),
requires `admin_group_value`

admin_group_value.description: Value in the admin group claim that grants admin privileges (e.g., "kellnr-admins")

auto_provision_users.description: Automatically create local user accounts for new `OAuth2` users

auto_redirect.description: Skip the login page and redirect straight to the SSO provider (requires `enforced`)

button_text.description: Text displayed on the `OAuth2` login button

enforced.description: Enforce SSO-only login, disabling local password login/change/reset and user creation (requires `enabled`)

read_only_group_claim.description:
Claim name to check for read-only group membership (e.g., "groups"),
requires `read_only_group_value`

read_only_group_value.description: Value in the read-only group claim that grants read-only access (e.g., "kellnr-readonly")

auto_redirect.description: Whether the login page should redirect straight to the SSO provider

button_text.description: Text to display on the login button

enforced.description: Whether local password login is disabled (SSO-only)

cookie_secure.description:
Force the `Secure` flag on cookies (true) or never set it (false).
Unset, cookies are secure only when `protocol` is https. Set it to true
when Kellnr is reached over https through a TLS-terminating proxy but
`protocol` is http

page.description: Number of the page, starting at 0

total.description: Number of crates on all pages

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Connect timeout in seconds for upstream requests

request_timeout_seconds.description: Request timeout in seconds for upstream downloads

user_agent.description:
User-agent sent with requests to crates.io. crates.io's data-access
policy asks for a user-agent that identifies the application and a way
to get in contact, e.g. "kellnr.io/kellnr (contact@example.com)".

secret.description:
Optional secret to sign deliveries according to the Standard Webhooks
specification. Base64 encoded, optionally prefixed with `whsec_`, at
least 24 bytes. The secret is never returned by the API.

auth_failed_attempts_window_seconds.description: Window in seconds for counting password attempts per username

auth_max_failed_attempts.description:
Password attempts allowed per username within the window before
further attempts are rejected with HTTP 429 (0 = disabled). Applies to
web UI login and cargo basic auth; a successful login resets the count

cache_max_size.description:
Max total size of the in-memory crate cache in MB (0 = no size limit,
only `cache_size` applies)

cache_size.description: Max number of crates in the in-memory crate cache (0 = disabled)

cookie_signing_key.description:
Cookie signing key (for multi-instance setups). At least 64 bytes of
random data; generate it with e.g. `openssl rand -hex 64`. Unset, a
random key is generated on every start

data_dir.description: Data directory for crates, index, and database

download_counter_flush_seconds.description: Download counter flush interval in seconds (0 = flush every download)

download_timeout_seconds.description: Download request timeout in seconds (0 = disabled)

new_crates_restricted.description: Restrict new crate uploads to admins

session_age_seconds.description:
Session lifetime in seconds, counted from the login (0 = sessions
never expire)

sponsor_links_enabled.description: Show links to sponsor Kellnr in the web UI and the startup log

token_db_retry_delay_ms.description: Token DB retry delay in ms

RegistryFilter.description:
Filters for downloads of crates hosted in Kellnr.

The fields are the same as in [`CratesioFilter`].

license_enabled.description: Deny downloads of crates whose license is not allowed

license_exempt_crates.description: Crates (comma-separated) that are allowed regardless of their license

license_unknown.description:
Decision for crates without a known or valid license: "deny" or "allow".
A license that is no valid SPDX expression counts as unknown

SetChannelRequest.description: Request to set a channel's toolchain

Settings.description:
Pure configuration values, every leaf carries the active value, no
provenance attached. Provenance lives on the companion `SettingsProv`,
which is built by [`build_prov_with_cli`] and stored in the app state for
the one handler (`/settings`) that needs it.

additionalProperties.description: Represents the source of a configuration value.

SettingsResponse.description:
Settings response, the flattened `Settings`, the per-leaf source map
derived from the `SettingsProv`, and the compiled-in defaults the UI
uses to show "default: X" next to overridden values.

Secret leaves are redacted in `settings`, `defaults` and `leaves`: a set
secret is replaced by [`REDACTED`], an unset one is `null`.

`leaves` is the new dynamic schema: one entry per `SettingsProv` leaf with
the value, default, source, type, secret flag, optional CLI flag string
(auto-derived from clap) and optional label override. The Vue UI iterates
over this list instead of hand-maintaining a parallel per-leaf table.

prefixItems.description:
A crate version. It is always a valid `SemVer` version and is compared,
ordered and hashed like one, including build metadata. It is displayed,
serialized and stored as the version string it was parsed from.

max_size.description: Max toolchain archive size in MB

ToolchainComponentInfo.description: Information about an individual toolchain component (e.g., rustc, cargo)

hash.description: SHA256 hash of the component archive

storage_path.description: Path to the stored component archive

ToolchainTargetInfo.description: Toolchain target information (e.g., a specific archive for a target triple)

components.description: Individual components extracted from the combined archive

ToolchainTargetStatus.description:
Processing status of an uploaded toolchain target, stored as its
lowercase name.

TopCrates.description: The most downloaded crates, `None` if there are fewer crates.

Version.description:
A crate version. It is always a valid `SemVer` version and is compared,
ordered and hashed like one, including build metadata. It is displayed,
serialized and stored as the version string it was parsed from.

block_private_targets.description:
Refuse webhook deliveries to loopback, private and other non-public
addresses. Link-local and cloud metadata addresses are always refused.

ignore_env_proxy.description:
Connect to webhook targets directly instead of through a proxy set in
`HTTP_PROXY` or `HTTPS_PROXY`. Through a proxy, only the proxy's
address can be checked against the blocked targets.

post.description:
One-time backfill for existing deployments that switch `s3.docs_bucket`/
`gcs.docs_bucket` from unset to a bucket name: copies every file already
on local disk (both auto-generated and manually-published docs use the
same on-disk layout) into the now-configured backend. Non-destructive —
local files are left in place, so this is safe to re-run. Runs in the
background since a large registry can take minutes to copy; admin-only.
